title: P1-B2 thermodynamic interpolation and high-energy input sensitivity

benchmark.propagation: literal fixed-omega Eq. (B.2), scalar opacity, Euclidean chord
benchmark.sensitivity_mode: B.1 source frozen; only B.2 opacity profile inputs varied in 8--15 km

interpolation_comparison.direct_profile_method: At every path quadrature node, linearly interpolate T, mu_numu, mu_mu from the 1687-vertex profile and recompute the local B.16 kernel; split each chord at every profile-vertex crossing.
interpolation_comparison.opacity_table_method: Precompute the local reduced opacity on the 642-node radial grid, then linearly interpolate that opacity along the same path nodes, matching the current reference-style B.2 implementation.
interpolation_comparison.path_quadrature: 4-point Gauss-Legendre per profile-vertex segment; independent 8-point check
interpolation_comparison.susceptibility: 96-point Gauss-Legendre p integral over [0,1200] MeV; 96/128 and 128/192 checks at r=8,10,12.5,15,20,22,25 km
interpolation_comparison.interpretation: Nonlinear recomputation of the local kernel from the interpolated thermodynamic fields does not reveal a hidden total-opacity interpolation error. The maximum total-tau difference is 9.07e-6; the larger relative Compton-only difference is subdominant in the total for these rays.

finite_difference_log_sensitivities.note: Local first-order estimates only; not a formal confidence interval or profile error bound.

conclusions: The 642-node opacity interpolation versus direct recomputation of the local B.16 kernel from the 1687-vertex thermodynamic profile changes sampled total optical depths by at most 9.07e-6.

For the high-energy band, the B.2 luminosity is sensitive to the inner 8--15 km semi-Compton opacity: +/-10% T or mu_mu changes the source-frozen escaped luminosity by about +16/-15% or +20/-19%, respectively.
A physically correlated +/-10% T and mu_mu variation at fixed mu_mu/T changes the source-frozen high-energy luminosity by +37.05%/-32.36%.
The neutrino inverse-decay opacity is almost insensitive to a +/-10% mu_numu variation in 8--15 km: the high-energy escaped luminosity changes by less than 0.03%.
The large T and mu_mu stress-test responses are not supported profile uncertainties: Caputo T and mu_mu/T agree with original Bollig Figs. 1 and 4 at the 1e-4 relative scale over 5--15 km.
No source, opacity, coupling, profile, Fig. 7 curve, or axial-vector output is rescaled or changed.
limitations: The +/-10% variations are deliberately broad stress tests, not statistical uncertainty intervals.
The source is frozen by design to isolate B.2 transport response; this is not a self-consistent perturbed B.1+B.2 stellar model.
The profile is a public-figure reconstruction, not the original same-snapshot Garching table.
The direct profile-kernel versus opacity-table comparison is a targeted 36-ray diagnostic, not a full global rerun with the direct kernel evaluated at every path node.
